observations.query: SELECT id,name,applied_at FROM d1_migrations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' AND (name LIKE 'publication_%' OR name LIKE 'source_publication%' OR name LIKE 'source_admission%' OR name='public_serving_snapshot') ORDER BY name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS stored_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(scraped_at)<=julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stored_firstseen_today,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') AND julianday(scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(scraped_at)<=julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_firstseen_today,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility='eligible_verified' AND julianday(scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(scraped_at)<=julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_verified_label_firstseen_today,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') AND julianday(posted_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(posted_at)<=julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_sourceposted_today,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') AND julianday(posted_at)>julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_future_sourceposted,
    MAX(scraped_at) AS latest_firstseen FROM opportunities

SELECT source_id,is_active,ph_eligibility,inactive_reason,COUNT(*) AS stored,
    MIN(scraped_at) AS earliest_firstseen,MAX(scraped_at) AS latest_firstseen,MAX(posted_at) AS latest_sourceposted
    FROM opportunities WHERE julianday(scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(scraped_at)<=julianday(?)
    GROUP BY source_id,is_active,ph_eligibility,inactive_reason ORDER BY source_id

SELECT r.source_id,r.compliance_state,r.operational_state,r.policy_expiry,r.canary_max_new_items_per_tick,r.opt_out,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_opt_outs o WHERE o.source_id=r.source_id) AS durable_opt_out,
    p.mechanism,p.auth_class,p.cadence_min_minutes,p.cadence_max_minutes,e.id AS admission_id,e.policy_version,e.captured_at,e.expires_at,
    e.source_governance_revision,e.provider_governance_revision FROM source_registry r JOIN provider_profiles p ON p.id=r.provider_id
    LEFT JOIN source_admission_evidence e ON e.id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM source_admission_evidence WHERE source_id=r.source_id)
    WHERE r.provider_id='workable' AND r.operational_state IN ('active','canary') ORDER BY r.source_id

SELECT source_id,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,last_count,
    CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_error,updated_at FROM source_fetch_state
    WHERE source_id LIKE 'workable:%' OR source_id IN ('__scrape_run_lock__','__ingest_diag__') ORDER BY source_id

SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) AS events,
    MAX(timestamp) AS latest_event,MAX(CASE WHEN skipped=0 THEN timestamp END) AS latest_fetch,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fetched_events,SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ok=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_events,SUM(CASE WHEN not_modified=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unchanged_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=0 AND COALESCE(not_modified,0)=0 THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS changed_feed_item_observations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 AND LOWER(skip_reason) LIKE '%rotation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rotation_skips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 AND LOWER(skip_reason) LIKE '%cadence%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cadence_skips
    FROM source_fetch_events WHERE julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(timestamp)<=julianday(?)
    AND (source_id LIKE 'workable:%' OR source_id IN ('we-work-remotely','remotive','remote-ok','real-work-from-anywhere','jobicy-admin-support-apac','jobicy-supporting-apac'))
    GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id

SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) AS events,
    MAX(timestamp) AS latest_event,MAX(CASE WHEN skipped=0 THEN timestamp END) AS latest_fetch,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fetched_events,SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ok=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_events,SUM(CASE WHEN not_modified=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unchanged_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=0 AND COALESCE(not_modified,0)=0 THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS changed_feed_item_observations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 AND LOWER(skip_reason) LIKE '%rotation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rotation_skips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 AND LOWER(skip_reason) LIKE '%cadence%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cadence_skips
    FROM source_fetch_events WHERE julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(timestamp)<=julianday(?)
    AND (source_id LIKE 'workable:%' OR source_id IN ('we-work-remotely','remotive','remote-ok','real-work-from-anywhere','jobicy-admin-support-apac','jobicy-supporting-apac'))
    GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id

SELECT timestamp,COUNT(*) AS events,SUM(CASE WHEN ok=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN skipped=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped FROM source_fetch_events
    WHERE julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT source_id,mode,COUNT(*) AS receipts,SUM(proposed_count) AS proposed,SUM(published_count) AS reported_published,
    SUM(json_array_length(published_ids_json)) AS id_occurrences,
    SUM(CASE WHEN published_count<>json_array_length(published_ids_json) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_id_disagreement_receipts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(published_ids_json) j WHERE j.type<>'integer' OR j.value<=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_id_receipts,
    MIN(decided_at) AS earliest_receipt,MAX(decided_at) AS latest_receipt FROM source_publication_ledger
    WHERE julianday(decided_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(decided_at)<=julianday(?) GROUP BY source_id,mode ORDER BY source_id,mode

WITH receipt_ids AS (SELECT l.source_id,j.value AS opportunity_id FROM source_publication_ledger l
    JOIN json_each(l.published_ids_json) j WHERE julianday(l.decided_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(l.decided_at)<=julianday(?) AND j.type='integer' AND j.value>0),
    unique_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT source_id,opportunity_id FROM receipt_ids)
    SELECT r.source_id,COUNT(*) AS unique_ids,SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(o.source_id,'unattributed')<>r.source_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_mismatch_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_active=1 AND o.ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currently_public_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_active=1 AND o.ph_eligibility='eligible_verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currently_verified_label_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(o.scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(o.scraped_at)<=julianday(?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstseen_today_ids,
    MIN(o.scraped_at) AS oldest_firstseen,MAX(o.scraped_at) AS newest_firstseen FROM unique_ids r LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id=r.opportunity_id GROUP BY r.source_id ORDER BY r.source_id

SELECT id,generated_at,refresh_started_at,LENGTH(payload) AS payload_chars,json_array_length(payload,'$.jobs') AS jobs_array_count,json_array_length(payload,'$.opportunities') AS opportunities_array_count,json_array_length(payload,'$.companies') AS companies_array_count FROM public_serving_snapshot WHERE id=1

SELECT id,source_id,posted_at,scraped_at,ph_eligibility,last_verified_at,location_type FROM opportunities
    WHERE is_active=1 AND ph_eligibility IN ('eligible_verified','eligible_likely') AND julianday(scraped_at)>=julianday(?) AND julianday(scraped_at)<=julianday(?) ORDER BY id
